title: File:Hoodoos in the Bryce Canyon National Park.jpg
desc: The hoodoos in the Bryce Canyon National Park. I took this image without flash or other additional artificial lightning. This is a contre-jour shot. The hoodoos are illuminated by reflected sunlight coming from the hoodoos in front of them.
